name: bb-plugin-switchboard
description: A compact list of the chats open in your bb panes, with bb's own chat sliding open in place. Made for a small second bb window.

bb.name: Switchboard
bb.description: A page listing the chats open in your split panes, in any bb window, with a state word each (Needs you, Working, Done, Idle), and a Waiting view of every thread waiting on you across all sections: asking you, replies you haven't read, FYI from other threads, and what's working. Click a row and bb's chat slides open in place; Ask the desk opens today's front desk thread, and a + beside it starts a blank chat on your project checkout. The title bar shows your plan's session and week usage. The rail icon counts what's asking you or has replied. Sized for a 500px second window (Cmd+Shift+N), where bb's side panel slides out beside the list instead of covering it and thread links open in the slide; it works in the main window too. Cmd+Shift+S opens it.
